messages:
Maya: Quick sync - finalise landing copy for Q2 launch. Need three lanes: Hosted, Dedicated, Private. Also a 30m webinar hook + 3 social posts + simple lead routing.

AJ: Hero tone options: PLG (fast time-to-value) vs Trust (SLOs & reliability). Recommend PLG for Hosted, Trust for Dedicated, Security for Private.

Noah: Draft hero lines (<=10 words):
- Hosted: "Ship LLM features in hours. SDKs, streaming, easy onboarding."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity with predictable SLOs and burst."
- Private: "Private control plane, KMS, audit trails for regs."

Lina: Webinar: 30m demo + benchmark + migration checklist. Title: "Prototype -> Production: Inference cost & latency playbook" CTA: Register (limited seats).

AJ: Social posts (short):
- Hosted: "From prompt to prod in hours. Demo + live Q&A. <link> #llmdev"
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, predictable cost. See benchmarks. <link> #sre"
- Private: "Bring inference into your VPC. KMS & audit logs. <link> #security"

Noah: Bench blurbs (for cards, internal):
- "30% lower p95 latency at 2k tokens vs baseline"
- "2x effective throughput with smart batching"
- "Up to 40% unit-cost reduction after caching"

Lina: Routing YAML for ops (simple):
```
source: webinar_signup
utm_campaign: q2_launch
rules:
  - if: company_size >= 500
    route: AE_Enterprise
  - if: contains(tags, 'security')
    route: AE_Enterprise
  - if: intent_score >= 7
    route: AE_SDR_Priority
  - else:
    route: SDR
send_notifications: [sales, marketing_ops]
```

Maya: Add mini-FAQ on landing: model compatibility, quantization profiles, support tiers (3 bullets each). Noah to finalize copy EOD.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Launch copy review - Tue 09:30 PT (30m) - attendees: Maya, AJ, Noah, Lina

AJ: I'll build landing skeleton and wire tracking to SFDC campaign q2_launch.

Maya: Thanks team, will review assets in the meeting.

Noah: Uploading drafts to #assets now.
